networkPolicy.desc: Video ads, YouTube and Vimeo are blocked; the audio stays open

notes: Written from the binary and from the tunnel. It is a Cordova web application (assets/www). What it needs: api.doscast.co.il and media.doscast.co.il, and Firebase. Blocked: VAST video ads from go.aniview.com and Google IMA, Google Tag Manager, and the YouTube and Vimeo players the code embeds (through cdn.plyr.io, with noembed.com for oEmbed). What it costs: any episode published as a YouTube or Vimeo video will not play. googlevideo.com stream hosts cannot be listed exactly, which is why the player hosts are what is blocked.
